messages:
Aisha (People Ops): Quick thread — I'm drafting a compact Day 0–7 checklist for incoming team leads (starts Mon). TL;DR: access, intros, first-1:1 schedule, and a 30/60/90 skeleton. Please skim and call out anything missing.

Aisha (People Ops): Draft checklist:
- Day 0: confirm SSO + corp laptop imaged
- Day 0: Slack, email, calendar invites + team channel join
- Day 0: Access: GitHub org, infra (Terraform), CI/CD (GitHub Actions), metrics (Grafana), logs (Sentry)
- Day 1: 30-min sync with hiring manager + People Ops intro
- Day 2: infra walk-through with Sam
- Day 3: security & compliance briefing with Jules
- By EOW: 30/60/90 draft due, baseline goals, ownership list

Aisha (People Ops): Who-to-ask quick map:
- Laptop imaging & hardware: @it-support
- SSO / Okta issues: @security
- GitHub org invites: @ravi
- Terraform/provider creds: @sam
- Pager / on-call enrollment: @eng-oncall

Aisha (People Ops): Access commands to run if blocked (ask Sam before running):
```
# check Okta groups
okta-ctl list-groups --user email@redwood.ai
# request infra role
infra-cli request-role --role team-lead --team TEAM_SLUG
```

Ravi (Eng): Add repo permissions note — make sure to request both org and repo-level teams. I'll pre-invite them if you DM me the hire's github handle.

Sam (DevOps): FYI for Terraform creds we currently use short-lived roles via Vault. Put the hire in `se-team-leads` group and they get a 24h token. I'll add that to the onboarding doc.

Priya (Hiring Manager): Can People Ops join the first 1:1? I usually run a 30-min kickoff to align expectations and hand over first-week priorities.

Aisha (People Ops): Yes — happy to join. Proposal: 30-min first 1:1 with Hiring Manager + People Ops at Day 1 10am. Also a 60-min team intro lunch (virtual) Day 2 noon.

Jules (Security): Quick risk callout — if the hire will access PCI or PHI datasets, we need completed DLP training before granting dataset roles. Flag me early.

onboard-bot: Reminder: assign mentor in People Ops onboard workflow within 24h :bell:

Ravi (Eng): I'll prepopulate a 30/60/90 template in the hire's Notion page. Suggest owners for first sprint: onboarding tasks assigned to mentor + hiring manager.

Aisha (People Ops): 30/60/90 skeleton (one-page):
- 30 days: access, basics of codebase, ship a small PR, meet cross-functional partners
- 60 days: take ownership of a service, lead roadmap item planning, mentor pairing
- 90 days: measurable impact (latency/cost/bug reduction), present to team, 1:1 rhythm established

Priya (Hiring Manager): One more — add 'communication preferences' to the first-week intake (async vs meetings, preferred tools).

Aisha (People Ops): Done. I'll update the template and send calendar invites. If anyone sees missing infra contact, shout here. :slightly_smiling_face:

Sam (DevOps): I'll follow up with a short DM to Aisha to confirm Vault group add. Also will post a short runbook in #devops-docs with the quick commands.

Ravi (Eng): Thanks — I'll wait for the GitHub handle and pre-invite.

Aisha (People Ops): Great — final ask: hiring manager, drop hire's name & GitHub handle here once confirmed and I'll start the invites and 30/60/90 doc.

Priya (Hiring Manager): Sending now: "Taylor Nguyen" — GitHub: tnguyen-redwood. Thanks all!

Aisha (People Ops): Received, starting invites. :rocket:
